messages:
toni: craving something nostalgic tonight  anyone up for a retro mixtape swap? also want a 2045min feel-good movie rec to watch between tracks. low-key, smiley, not rom-com sappy.
mike: love this. mixtape idea: odd 80s synth + 90s alt + early 00s indie. keeps it warm and a little bittersweet. movie: 'The Station Agent' is 89m so nope. for 30ish: 'The Straight Story' is gentle and weirdly uplifting (~112m)  okay too long.
yasmin: for a short feel-good watch try 'Please Give' (90m) also long. hmm. 40min-ish doc? 'The Wonders' no. okay brain fart.
greg: mixtape starter rec: 1) Aztec Camera  'Somewhere in My Heart' 2) The La's  'There She Goes' 3) Camera Obscura  'Lloyd, I'm Ready to Be Heartbroken' -> sets a nostalgic but light tone.
mike: playlist-bot: can you create a public playlist called 'retro-mixtape-toni'  and add those three + a few b-sides? @playlist-bot
playlist-bot: Created playlist "retro-mixtape-toni"  18 tracks  41m total. Link: https://music.internal/playlists/retro-mixtape-toni
yasmin: for 3040min watch: short festival film 'The Big Snit' is 10min (animated), or try a single episode of 'Modern Love' (approx 30m)  feels sentimental but tasteful.
toni: Modern Love S1E1 is perfect — 35m and small moments. adding that to the queue. thanks!
greg: bonus snack rec: buttered popcorn with a sprinkle of nutritional yeast. weirdly savory and feels retro.
yasmin: love the snack idea. ok mixtape queued, Modern Love cued. sharing pics of my record shelf if anyone wants inspo :vintage_record: :camera_with_flash:
toni: best internet pals. sending virtual cookies and a promise to swap actual tapes someday :cookie:
